plane_arithmetic_proof: Each bit position is an independent action lane storing dd minus current region matches. delta>0 subtracts one with borrow; every covered region contains the formerly mismatched cell, so its deficit is at least1. delta<0 adds one with carry; each region previously matched that cell, so deficit is at mostdd-1. Therefore all updated values remain0..dd, fit four bits, and cannot overflow the five-plane buffer. Carry masks remain inside finite cover_bits even when using Python bitwise complement.
performance_review: No new asymptotic concern found. Extra cover bitsets are bounded by one board geometry in a contest process; weighted state remains unchanged. No timing claim added by this read-only review.
